name: snote: Simplenote in your terminal
author: qteamdon
description: Unofficial Simplenote client for your terminal. Browse, search and write your Simplenote notes from the keyboard, with a one-click bar button, and send a note to your Skryf blog as a draft. The first click installs snote; no build step.

barWidget.description: Open or focus snote, an unofficial Simplenote client, from the bar. Installs the pre-built app the first time.
